questions.prompt: P(r) = 5000(1 + r)¹⁰ with r > 0 is the value of an investment. Without calculating, explain why P(r) > 5000.
questions.prompt_markup: P(r) = 5000(1 + r)¹⁰ with r > 0 is the value of an investment. Without calculating, explain why P(r) > 5000.
questions.correct_answer: 1 + r > 1, so (1 + r)¹⁰ > 1, and 5000 times a number greater than 1 is greater than 5000.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent explanation that treats (1 + r)¹⁰ as one quantity greater than 1.

questions.prompt: The height of a ball is h(t) = 80 - 16(t - 2)² feet after t seconds. Without expanding, find the greatest height and when it occurs, and explain.
questions.prompt_markup: The height of a ball is h(t) = 80 - 16(t - 2)² feet after t seconds. Without expanding, find the greatest height and when it occurs, and explain.
questions.correct_answer: 80 ft at t = 2: (t - 2)² ≥ 0, so 16(t - 2)² ≥ 0 and h(t) ≤ 80, with equality only when t = 2.
questions.grading_note: Form required: the height, the time, and the reason.

questions.prompt: C(x) = 10 + 40/(x + 1) is a cost in dollars for x ≥ 0. Explain why C(x) is always more than 10 and never more than 50.
questions.prompt_markup: C(x) = 10 + 40/(x + 1) is a cost in dollars for x ≥ 0. Explain why C(x) is always more than 10 and never more than 50.
